gate.future_execution_rule: Executable means complete callable specification and oracle with declared runtime dependencies, not prior PASS of P02-P06. REVIEW may require later evidence when run; its procedure/input schema must exist at preflight.
gate.predicate: len(cases)==36 AND all(case.preflight_executable AND fixture_complete AND independent_oracle_complete AND required_capabilities_qualified for case in cases) AND contract_conflicts==[]

minimality_limit: Four shared-authoring boundaries; sufficient dependency ordering, not a proof of globally minimal package count.

packages.ACCEPTANCE: 6/6 complete and independently admissible; 78 O01 cells bound; native required fields/references present; no actual outputs or execution asserted; no null role/policy binding.
packages.WORK: Author one closed typed source/identity/policy/envelope registry and all six full O01/native definitions in two ordered substeps. References may be forward-declared then resolved uniquely.

packages.ACCEPTANCE: Proof/authority source-disjoint positive/negative witnesses; T01 ingress pins, matching route source class and pre-existing ATTEST; no checkpoint evidence; known mainline and unknown variant; C03 and post-reentry Action predicates fully bound.
